blocks.title: POC Contacts
rows: Who to email, and who to copy
All communication with HQ POCs is on email. Address the POC who owns the issue; copy every related POC and your RH.
Branch operations, machine breakdowns and repairs, infrastructure, CCTV, Issue Tracker escalations
Complaints, unhappy or escalated clients, service failures, feedback-call issues
Stock requests, deliveries, stock mismatches, expiry; Zoho Inventory ID, password or discrepancy issues
Attendance, leave, staffing, replacements, staff concerns; branch asset records, missing or damaged assets
Clients unhappy with results, poor or slow response to treatment, protocol questions
Keep both POCs in the loop. A machine breakdown that delays booked treatments: to Saurabh, copy Dr Navreet. A stock shortage that stops a treatment: to Aditya, copy Saurabh and Dr Navreet.
[Branch] · [Area] · [Short issue] · [Date]. Body: what happened, client or item affected, what you have done, what you need, by when.
Patient-safety, security or major cash issues may be phoned first, but are confirmed on email the same day.
Log the issue in the Issue Tracker with the email date; reply on the same thread until it is closed with evidence.
Every client gets two calls within 24 hours of every visit: one from the doctor and one from the Feedback Team.
Enter every visit the same day, before the client leaves: name, mobile number (read back), treatment and session number, doctor and therapist, any concern, visit status and next appointment.
At 6:15 PM, check every visit of the day is in the system and complete; fix gaps before 7:00 PM. A client not reached because of wrong details is a missed entry in the BM Daily Log.

blocks.title: BM Timetable
rows: BM day at a glance · 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM
Clinic opens (FDM has readied every room). Walk the branch as a patient would. Attendance, late arrivals, grooming. Headline numbers from the FDM debrief. Check last evening’s signed cash slip.
Opening photo and confirmation by 9:45; attendance marked; late arrivals reported
Reception 5 min, housekeeping 5 min (Hindi), counsellors 10 min, one station at a time. Assign duties.
Duties confirmed on WhatsApp; staff and cleanliness photos
Six agenda items, in a 20-minute slot kept free in the doctor’s diary.
Yesterday’s numbers in full; reply to the FDM debrief. Mark VIPs, complaint follow-ups, 5th-session+ patients. Physical stock check. HQ inbox. Plan the day in three buckets.
20 minutes each; personal greeting for 1–2 VIPs.
Full clinic round with photos of every area, every 2 hours after the 9:30 opening photos.

Observe 2 live consultations. Audit 5 CRM records from yesterday. Issue Tracker, machines, CCTV. Escalated complaints (callback in 48h). Airtable same day. Every visit entered with correct details for the 24-hour doctor and feedback calls. Every issue emailed to the right POC, related POCs copied (see POC Contacts).
Check every visit of the day is in the system with correct details (24-hour call rule). BM Daily Log, BM EOD report, stock report. Owed callbacks. Note to HQ if anything material.
Daily Log, EOD report, stock report
Reconcile Cash, Card and UPI with reception for billing up to 6:30 PM; explain variances. Washroom checklist photo.
Thank 2–3 people by name; acknowledge the hard parts.
Reports submitted. 5-line WhatsApp to the RH. Handover note to the FDM. Plan tomorrow’s first half-hour. Off duty at 7:00.
Post-6:30 billing reconciled and sealed with a signed slip; closing audit; FDM debrief by 8:00 PM.
Checked by the BM at 9:30 next morning

blocks.title: Daily Checklist
rows: BM daily checklist · 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM
Arrived at 9:30; clinic open, every room ready
Attendance, late arrivals and grooming checked
Last evening’s FDM cash slip and debrief checked
Huddles held: reception, housekeeping, counsellors; duties on WhatsApp
Numbers read, physical stock check done, plan made
Issue Tracker updated; machines and CCTV checked
Every visit in the system with correct name, mobile, treatment, doctor (24-hour calls)
Daily Log, BM EOD report and stock report filled
Cash, Card and UPI reconciled to the 6:30 cut-off
WhatsApp summary to RH; handover note to FDM
Every issue emailed to the right POC, related POCs and RH copied
Mark each task Done, Missed or NA. Completion % = Done ÷ (Done + Missed); NA does not count.
Verdict: G at or above the green level on How to Use, A at or above the amber level, R below it.
Arrival after the shift start shows red; sign-off before the shift end shows amber.
